battle.name: 金軍三道攻宋之戰
battle.brief: 一二一九年，金以僕散安貞為統帥，分三道自河南、川陝、淮南南下：西路破興元、大安軍，中路圍襄樊棗陽，東路渡淮直抵采石。趙方守城，孟宗政以砲手、坑道火煙破敵雲梯，棗陽合戰大破金營，宋軍再以六萬分三道北伐。金廷折耗，樞府精騎十不存一，一二二四年收兵。配重投石車是此役攻城器械一環。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 金軍三道攻宋之戰是一二一七年至一二二四年金朝對南宋發動的連續攻擊，核心是一二一九年以僕散安貞為統帥的三路南侵。金朝方面：宣宗完顏珣自一二一四年五月自中都燕京遷都開封，國土只剩河南數州，又遭蒙古於野狐嶺及三路攻金之役重創，一二一五年中都失守，遂欲取償於宋，轉而向南方索取糧秣與歲幣。兵員以河南兩路統軍司調發，倚樞府武騎為精幹；帥臣有烏古論慶壽、完顏賽不、完顏阿鄰、完顏贇、完顏訛可等，各領一路，金廷以僕散安貞為左副元帥輔太子守緒統攝全局。南宋方面：寧宗趙擴採真德秀之議，於一二一四年罷金歲幣而不出兵，對蒙古攻金保持中立；邊防分由京湖制置使趙方、江淮制置使李珏、四川制置使董居誼便宜行事，兵力除禁軍外，更倚山東紅襖軍李全等降眾與沿邊忠義軍。金廷內部以朮虎高琪主戰，平章政事胥鼎力諫南侵六不可而不用；又因無力出援西夏，與夏絕和，宋夏遂得聯手夾攻。金宋兩國在河南、江淮、荊襄、川陝四個方向同時拉鋸，疆界犬牙交錯，沒有穩定前線。
countriesEn: The Jin three-pronged war against Song was a series of attacks by the Jin dynasty on the Southern Song between 1217 and 1224, whose core was the three-route invasion of 1219 under the command of Pusan Anzhen. On the Jin side: Xuanzong Wanyan Xun had moved the capital away from Zhongdu in Beijing to Kaifeng in May 1214, leaving the Jin with only a few prefectures of Henan; the state had been badly mauled at Yehuling and in the three-pronged Mongol offensive against Jin, and in 1215 Zhongdu was lost, so the court turned on Song, meaning to make good its losses and to draw grain and the old tribute in the south. Troops were drawn from the two Henan military districts, with the Pufu cavalry as the hard core. The commanders included Wugulun Qingshou, Wanyan Saibu, Wanyan Alin, Wanyan Yun and Wanyan Nianke, each leading one route, with Pusan Anzhen as left deputy marshal assisting Crown Prince Shouxu in the overall direction. On the Song side: Emperor Ningzong Zhao Kuan acted on the advice of Zhen Dexiu and in 1214 stopped the tribute to Jin without going to war, staying neutral while the Mongols attacked Jin. The frontier was handled by the Jinghu circuit commissioner Zhao Fang, the Jianghuai circuit commissioner Li Jue and the Sichuan circuit commissioner Dong Juyi, each with discretionary authority; besides the regular army the Song relied on the surrendered bands of Li Quan of the Shandong Red Coat army and on loyalist volunteers along the border. Inside the Jin the war party was led by the chancellor Shuhu Gaoqi, while the chancellor Xu Ding argued at length that there were six reasons against invading the south and was not listened to; the Jin also had no troops to aid Western Xia and so broke with the Xia, which allowed Song and Xia to strike at Jin together. The two states fought along four fronts at once, in Henan, the Huai and Yangtze, Jingxiang and Shaanxi, on a frontier that was jagged and had no stable line.
people: 金方核心是宣宗完顏珣與太子守緒。宣宗在野狐嶺敗績與中都失守之後把希望寄在南方，一二一七年四月下令南侵，命烏古論慶壽、完顏賽不為帥：慶壽渡淮，攻光州中渡鎮，捕獲榷場官盛允升；賽不分兵犯樊城，圍棗陽、光化軍；完顏阿鄰取大散關，進窺西和、階、成州。一二一七年末金主以僕散安貞為左副元帥，輔太子守緒會師南下；僕散安貞於一二一九年統三路大舉，二一二一年再至漢陽軍抵長江而還。完顏訛可於一二一九年七月以步騎傅棗陽城，圍城八十餘日，兵潰單騎遁走；二一二二年以元帥左監軍再統三路，渡淮戰於高塘市，遇淮水暴漲全軍覆沒，事後被誅。完顏贇以步騎萬人入川，兵敗被斬。謀主朮虎高琪力勸侵宋，平章政事胥鼎力諫六不可，呂子羽奉命議和至淮中流不納，和好遂絕。宋方最見功者是京湖制置使趙方，他力主出戰，親赴襄陽，檄令扈再興、陳祥、孟宗政禦敵，又在棗陽合戰前夕定下先發制人之策，遣三將帥六萬分三道北伐。孟宗政權知棗陽，築堤積水、修治城堞，募砲手、掘坑防地道、施毒煙烈火，終以內外夾擊破金營，斬其眾三萬，隨軍收編中原遺民以萬數為忠順軍，金人呼之為「孟爺爺」。扈再興領西路攻鄧州，屢與金人接戰；許國守隨州、攻唐州，部將耶律均於比陽斬金將李提控。山東紅襖軍首領李全降宋，在化湖陂、曹家莊連敗金軍並獲其金牌，賈涉據此請賞，授李全廣州觀察使。四川一路，張威使石宣於大安軍邀擊，大破金軍，殲精兵三千、擒巴士魯安；興元都統吳政戰歿於黃牛堡；四川制置使董居誼棄成都而遁。
peopleEn: At the centre of the Jin side were Xuanzong Wanyan Xun and the crown prince Shouxu. After the defeat at Yehuling and the loss of Zhongdu, the khan placed his hopes on the south: in April 1217 he ordered the invasion and named Wugulun Qingshou and Wanyan Saibu as commanders. Qingshou crossed the Huai and struck at Zhongduzhen in Guangzhou, taking the customs official Sheng Yunsheng prisoner; Saibu divided his force to attack Fancheng and to invest Zaoyang and Guanghua army; Wanyan Alin took Dasan Pass and pushed towards Xihe, Jie and Chengzhou. At the end of 1217 the khan made Pusan Anzhen left deputy marshal to assist the crown prince in a joint march south. Pusan Anzhen commanded the three great routes in 1219, and in 1221 came again as far as Hanyang army on the Yangtze before turning back. In July 1219 Wanyan Nianke brought foot and horse up to the walls of Zaoyang; after more than eighty days of investment his army broke and he fled alone on horseback. In 1222, as left vice-commander of the marshal's office he again led three routes, crossed the Huai and fought at Gaotangshi, where the swollen river destroyed his whole army; he was executed afterwards. Wanyan Yun took ten thousand foot and horse into Sichuan and was cut down after his defeat. The chief advocate of the war was the chancellor Shuhu Gaoqi, who pressed the khan to invade; the chancellor Xu Ding argued that there were six reasons against it, and Li Ziwei, sent to negotiate peace, was not received at the middle channel of the Huai, after which relations were severed. The man who stood out on the Song side was the Jinghu circuit commissioner Zhao Fang. He insisted on fighting, went in person to Xiangyang, called on Hu Zaixing, Chen Xiang and Meng Zongzheng to hold the line, and, before the combined assault on Zaoyang, settled on a policy of striking first, sending three commanders with sixty thousand men along three routes into Jin territory. Meng Zongzheng, who took charge of Zaoyang, raised a levee to hold water, repaired the parapets, enlisted stone-throwers, sank deep pits against tunnels and used poison smoke and fire, and finally broke the Jin camp by attack from within and without, killing some thirty thousand of them; he enrolled the refugees who came back from the Central Plains, several tens of thousands of them, as the Zhunshun army, and the Jin called him Master Meng. Hu Zaixing led the western route against Dengzhou and fought the Jin repeatedly; Xu Gou held Suizhou and attacked Tangzhou, and his officer Yelü Jun killed the Jin commander Li TIKONG at Biyang. Li Quan, the leader of the Shandong Red Coat army, came over to Song, beat the Jin at Hualhubi and Caojiazhuang and captured a Jin tally, on which Jia She petitioned for his reward and Li Quan was given the title of Guangzhou jiancha shi. In Sichuan, Zhang Wei sent Shi Xuan to intercept the enemy at Da'an army and routed them, destroying three thousand of their elite and taking Busilu'an prisoner; the Xingyuan commander Wu Zheng fell in battle at Huangniu fort; and the Sichuan circuit commissioner Dong Juyi abandoned Chengdu and fled.
kits: 卡面兵器是配重投石車，古代稱砲、抛石車，宋人亦稱飛石，元人稱回回砲。以長木為臂，臂端繫筐，筐中盛石或彈，另一端懸以配重櫓，絞索收放，靠重力把石彈甩過城頭。中國自北宋即有成熟配重砲與人力砲，十二世紀已用於攻城；蒙古自一二一一年攻金時大量徵用漢人與回回工匠操作回回砲，一二一四年至一二一五年圍中都，金廷正是在這等砲火下失守燕京，故金人對砲之毀傷與對其反制都有切身經驗。金人自己的砲火傳統更早，南侵宋境時已用霹靂砲與飛石，《岳飛傳》記順昌之役金人用霹靂砲轟擊宋營；不過霹靂砲以火藥填殼中炸發，與純以配重拋射石塊的配重投石車並非一物。就本戰役的記載看，一二一九年攻宋所見的金人攻城器械主要是雲梯、天橋、地道與火箭：棗陽之役金選精騎二千號為弩手，擁雲梯、天橋先登，又募鑿銀鑛石工晝夜鑿城、運茆葦逼近城樓欲以火焚之，卻不見配重砲的記載。真正與之相應的是守城一方的投射砲石：孟宗政囊糠盛沙以覆樓栅，列甕瀦水以隄火，募砲手擊之，一砲輒殺數人，正以拋射之石壓制登城雲梯。除攻城器外，雙方尚有蹶張弩、弓、火箭、長槍與重甲：金軍精兵披厚鎧、氈衫、鐵面，持弩手二千；宋軍結長槍勁弩之陣，備毒煙、火山、濕氈以拒攻。糧秣與載具同樣決定戰局：金軍入川所獲糧九萬斛、錢數千萬，宋軍則靠忠義軍就地給田創屋、就食於唐鄧之間。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the counterweight trebuchet, known in antiquity as the pao, the stone-throwing carriage, called also the flying stone by the Song and the Huihui pao by the Yuan. A long timber forms the arm; a basket of stone or shot is slung at one end, and a counterweight is hung at the other, and the arm is hauled up and released on ropes, so that gravity alone throws the stone over the wall. China had both a developed counterweight pao and a manpower pao by the time of the Northern Song, and they were already used in sieges in the twelfth century. When the Mongols took the war against Jin in 1211 they recruited Chinese and Huihui technicians in large numbers to work the Huihui pao, and during the investment of Zhongdu in 1214 and 1215 the Jin court lost Yanjing to exactly this sort of bombardment, so the Jin had direct experience both of what stone-throwers did and of how to answer them. The Jin had their own tradition of bombards much earlier: when they invaded Song they already used the thunder crash bomb and flying stones, and the biography of Yue Fei records that at Shunchang the Jin used the thunder crash bomb against the Song camp; the thunder crash bomb was a shell filled with gunpowder and burst in flight, and was therefore a different instrument from a counterweight trebuchet, which throws plain stone. As the record of this campaign stands, the siege equipment the Jin brought against Song in 1219 was chiefly ladders, gangways, tunnels and fire: in the siege of Zaoyang the Jin picked two thousand of their best horse and called them crossbowmen, and they went up with ladders and gangways; they also hired stone-workers to cut the walls day and night and carried reed matting up to the round towers to burn them. No counterweight pao appears in that account. What corresponds to it on the defending side was the stone thrown from the walls: Meng Zongzheng filled sacks with chaff and sand to cover the parapets, stood jars of water to check fire, and enlisted stone-throwers whose one shot killed several men apiece, using the flying stones to pin the ladders against the wall. Beyond the siege engines both sides had the Chinese crossbow, the bow, fire arrows, the long spear and heavy armour: the Jin's picked troops wore thick mail, felt coats and iron face-masks, and they had two thousand crossbowmen; the Song formed lines of long spears and strong crossbows and prepared poison smoke, fire-pits and wet hides against assault. Supply and transport decided as much as the fighting: the Jin took some ninety thousand bushels of grain and countless strings of cash in Sichuan, while the Song fed their loyalist volunteers on the spot by granting them land and houses along the Tang and Deng roads.
tactics: 金軍的戰法是多路齊進而各自求勝。三道之中，西路取大散關後直趨蜀口，試圖由漢中入成都；中路以棗陽、樊城為支點反覆攻擊襄漢；東路渡淮後分兵掃掠滁、濠、光三州與安豐，遊騎直抵采石楊林渡，驚動建康。三路互不相屬，目標與期限不一，缺少統一節制，故始終不能合為一擊，只給了宋軍各個擊破的機會。金人攻城依賴雲梯、天橋、地道、火攻與日夜掘進，屢攻不下即改以火攻燒樓；宋軍的守城術更見細密：孟宗政到任先立新令、斬違令者以立威，隨即築堤積水、修治城堞、簡閱軍士，備妥器械；金人鑿地道則掘深坑防之，金人焚樓則先燬之、架火山以絕其路，又穿穽施毒煙烈火、鼓鞲薰之，使攻兵窒息；城頭築偃月城翼傅正城，以長槍勁弩備衝，長戈舂喉，敢勇軍自下夾擊，攻城者屢墜火中。趙方的處置尤見分寸：他不急於解圍，待金人頓兵棗陽城下八十餘日、氣力已竭，才召各軍合擊，內外夾攻，一戰而定。野戰上宋人善用設伏：團山之役扈再興佯卻誘敵深入，孟宗政與陳祥合兩翼掩擊，金兵三面受敵而大敗。宋軍自己也深知無攻城之器，趙方遣三將北伐時明令「毋深入，毋攻城，第潰其保甲，燬其城砦，空其貲糧而已」，只毀堡寨資糧而不攻坚城。時令與水文同樣左右勝負：一二一九年七月攻棗陽正當盛夏，久攻不下耗盡士氣；二一二二年金軍渡淮北返遇淮水暴漲，全軍覆沒，水文一變而全軍潰散。
tacticsEn: The Jin method was to advance on several routes at once and each to win on its own. Of the three, the western route took Dasan Pass and drove straight at the mouth of Sichuan, trying to enter Chengdu from Hanzhong; the central route used Zaoyang and Fancheng as pivots and hammered at Jingxiang again and again; the eastern route crossed the Huai and then swept in several columns through Chu, Hao and Guangzhou and Anfeng, its outriders reaching the Yanglin ford at Caishi and startling Jiankang. The three routes were not subordinate to one another, their objectives and their deadlines differed, and there was no unified command, so they never closed into a single blow and merely gave the Song army the chance to defeat them one at a time. The Jin siege depended on ladders, gangways, tunnels, fire and continuous digging by day and night, and when an assault failed they turned to burning the towers with fire. The Song defence was far more finely worked: when Meng Zongzheng took command he first issued new regulations and beheaded a servant who broke them to establish his authority, then raised a levee to hold water, repaired the parapets, counted the soldiers and had his equipment ready; against the Jin tunnels he sank deep pits, against the attempt to burn the towers he pulled them down first and built a fire-pit to cut off the approach, and he drove shafts for poison smoke and fire and beat the leather bellows so that the smoke rolled out and the attackers were smothered; on the wall he built a crescent work flanking the main wall, armed with long spears and strong crossbows against the rush, long poles to thrust at throats, and a bravestead from below to catch the climbers, so that the assaulting troops kept falling into the flames. Zhao Fang's handling showed particular judgement: he did not rush to relieve the siege, but waited until the Jin had lain eighty days before Zaoyang with their strength spent, and only then called the armies together for a combined attack from within and without, and the battle was settled in a single stroke. In the open field the Song were good at ambush: at Tuanshan Hu Zaixing feigned retreat to draw the enemy deep in, and Meng Zongzheng and Chen Xiang struck with the two wings, and the Jin, attacked on three sides, were routed. The Song knew their own lack of siege engines: when Zhao Fang sent the three commanders north he gave the explicit order not to penetrate deeply and not to besiege cities, but only to break up the garrisons, burn the forts and strongholds and empty the stores of grain, and so they destroyed stockades and supply without assaulting a single wall. The season and the rivers decided as much as the generals did: the assault on Zaoyang in the seventh month of 1219 fell in the height of summer, and the long fruitless assault drained the attackers' strength; and in 1222 the Jin army, withdrawing north across the Huai, met the swollen river, and the whole force was drowned and scattered, a change of the water alone undoing the army.
data: 可核的數字散見於《宋史紀事本末》《金史》等處。戰事自一二一七年四月金人分道入寇起，至一二二四年金人榜諭光州軍民更不南侵止，前後約八年。一二一七年十二月，完顏贇以步騎萬人犯四川；翌年三月宋軍收復時，僅利州統制王逸一部便動用官軍與忠義人十萬。一二一八年二月金人圍隨州、棗陽，與宋軍大小接戰七十餘戰，歷時三月；三月王逸追斬完顏贇，進攻秦州。一二一九年二月金人破興元府，繼破大安軍、洋州，宋將張威使石宣邀擊，殲其精兵三千，擒其將巴士魯安；是年十月趙方遣扈再興、許國、孟宗政帥師六萬，分三道北伐。一二一九年七月棗陽合戰，賈勇入金營，自晡至三更，殺金眾三萬，完顏訛可單騎遁走，宋軍追至馬磴寨、焚其城而入鄧州；圍城自春曉至七月共八十餘日，中原遺民來歸者以萬數。糧秣方面，一二一七年金兵入蜀前後獲糧九萬斛、錢數千萬。一二二〇年九月西夏樞密使甯子寧帥眾二十萬圍鞏州，與宋軍合勢攻金不克。距離上，汴京至棗陽約二百五十公里，至采石約五百五十公里，興元至大安軍約五百公里。一二二二年訛可再統三路渡淮，兵敗高塘市，值淮水暴漲，士卒皆覆沒，金廷自言「兵財由是大竭」；金人樞府精騎南伐之後，士馬折耗十不存一。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are scattered through the Songshi Jishi Benmo and the Jinshi. The war runs from the Jin entering by several routes in the fourth month of 1217 to the Jin posting their notice at Guangzhou in 1224 that they would invade no further, a matter of some eight years. In the twelfth month of 1217 Wanyan Yun took ten thousand foot and horse into Sichuan; when the Song recovered the ground in the third month of the following year, the single contingent of the Lizhou commander Wang Yi already used a hundred thousand of regulars and loyalist volunteers. In the second month of 1218 the Jin invested Suizhou and Zaoyang and fought the Song in some seventy engagements of greater and lesser size over three months; in the third month Wang Yi cut down Wanyan Yun and advanced on Qinzhou. In the second month of 1219 the Jin broke Xingyuan prefecture and then Da'an army and Yangzhou prefecture, and the Song general Zhang Wei sent Shi Xuan to intercept them, destroying three thousand of their picked troops and taking their commander Busilu'an prisoner; in the tenth month of that year Zhao Fang sent Hu Zaixing, Xu Gou and Meng Zongzheng with sixty thousand men along three routes into Jin territory. In the seventh month of 1219, in the combined assault on Zaoyang, Jia Yong entered the Jin camp and from late afternoon until the third watch killed some thirty thousand of the enemy, and Wanyan Nianke fled alone on horseback; the Song pursued them to the Mading stockade, burned the town and entered Dengzhou. The siege had run from early spring to the seventh month, more than eighty days, and the refugees who came back from the Central Plains were counted in tens of thousands. As to supply, the Jin took some ninety thousand bushels of grain and countless strings of cash in Sichuan in 1217. In the ninth month of 1220 the Western Xia chancellor Ning Zining led two hundred thousand men to invest Guizhou and joined with the Song in pressing Jin, without success. As to distances, it is about two hundred and fifty kilometres from Bianjing to Zaoyang and about five hundred and fifty from Bianjing to Caishi, and about five hundred kilometres from Xingyuan to Da'an army. In 1222 Nianke led his three routes across the Huai once more, was beaten at Gaotangshi, and the swollen river drowned his army to the last man, the Jin court saying that from that hour its men and its wealth were exhausted; after the southern campaign the Jin cavalry of the Pufu was so worn down that not one man in ten remained.
cause: 直接導火線是歲幣。蒙古自一二一一年三路攻金，金人於野狐嶺等役屢敗，一二一四年五月宣宗被迫自中都遷都開封，一二一五年中都陷落，金土只剩河南數州；同年七月宋寧宗採真德秀之議罷金歲幣，中斷了以銀絹輸金的舊約。於是「歲幣不至」成了金南侵的現成口實。金廷主戰者眾：朮虎高琪勸以南伐可廣疆土，淮南招撫使王世安獻取盱眙、楚州之策，金主乃於一二一七年四月據此發兵渡淮，執榷場官盛允升。內外交困之下，金廷把向宋索取糧秣財貨視為取償於宋的辦法，而控制襄漢又可卡住蒙古由宋境南下的通道，戰略上的考慮與財務上的逼迫合流。平章政事胥鼎力諫南侵有六不可，參知政事高汝礪以金人請和之牒徒示微弱而止議和，金主終不聽；一二一七年十二月金主遣呂子羽至淮中流議和，被宋廷拒絕，和好遂絕，改以僕散安貞輔太子守緒會師南侵。此後金人屢攻不克，又值西夏受蒙古逼迫求援而金不能出兵，夏金絕和，宋夏得以聯手夾攻。財政才是更深的病根：金廷以河南數州養十餘萬大軍，糧餉不支，攻宋所得又被宋軍焚毀資糧，戰事越久，國用越困。
causeEn: The immediate spark was the tribute. The Mongols had opened the three-pronged war against Jin in 1211 and the Jin had been beaten at Yehuling and elsewhere; in May 1214 Xuanzong was forced to move the capital from Zhongdu to Kaifeng, and in 1215 Zhongdu fell, leaving the Jin no more than a few prefectures of Henan. In the seventh month of the same year Song Ningzong, following the advice of Zhen Dexiu, stopped the tribute to Jin and broke the old arrangement of paying silver and silk. The phrase the tribute has not come therefore became a ready pretext for a Jin invasion of the south. There were many at the Jin court who wanted war: Shuhu Gaoqi urged that a southern campaign would enlarge the territory, and Wang Shian, commissioner for the Huai area, offered a plan for taking Xuyi and Chuzhou, and in the fourth month of 1217 the khan acted on it, crossing the Huai and taking the customs official Sheng Yunsheng. Hemmed in on every side, the Jin court took the grain and treasure of Song as a form of compensation for its losses, while seizing Jingxiang would block the road by which the Mongols would come south through Song territory, so strategic calculation and financial pressure joined together. The chancellor Xu Ding argued that there were six reasons against a southern campaign; the chancellor Gao Ruli stopped the peace negotiations on the ground that the Jin's own note asking for peace only showed weakness; and in the end the khan did not listen. In the twelfth month of 1217 he sent Li Ziwei to the middle channel of the Huai to negotiate, was refused by the Song court, and relations were severed, the khan instead making Pusan Anzhen assist the crown prince Shouxu in a joint march south. The Jin attacks then went on failing, and when Western Xia, itself pressed by the Mongols, asked for help the Jin could not send troops; Xia and Jin broke off relations, and Song and Xia were able to strike at Jin together. Finance was the deeper sickness: the Jin court was feeding more than a hundred thousand men on a few prefectures of Henan, rations were short, and what the campaigns took from Song was itself burned and destroyed by the Song army, so the longer the war ran the tighter the state's finances became.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果，是金朝最後一次大規模南侵的落幕。南宋在襄漢、江淮與川陝三個方向穩住了陣腳，趙方、孟宗政等人守住了棗陽、樊城與興元等要點，把金人逐出河南南部，等於替南宋贏得數十年的邊疆屏障，荊襄一線從此成為南宋抗蒙的基地，日後端平入洛、聯蒙攻蔡州的戰略都建立在這段緩衝之上。技術上，這幾年雙方的攻防經驗被完整地記錄與傳播：守城方掘坑防地道、施毒煙烈火、鼓鞲薰之、以偃月城與火山隔絕登城者，攻城方以雲梯、天橋、地道與夜襲配合，雙方都加深了對大型攻城器械與砲火的認識，這些經驗後來在襄樊抗蒙的十年攻防中再次被檢驗。兵制的變化更為深遠：中原遺民成批歸宋，編為忠順軍，加上山東紅襖軍李全所部與各處忠義軍，南宋邊軍出現私軍化與軍頭勢力坐大的趨勢，李全因此得以由紅襖首領轉為受封觀察使，淮東一線的軍力此後幾乎不受朝廷節制，這既是南宋邊防的隐患，也是日後端平入洛時的隱憂。對金朝而言，樞府精騎十不存一、兵財大竭，北方又遭蒙古步步緊逼，終至一二三四年蔡州陷落，政權覆亡；回頭看，一二一九年的南侵耗盡了金朝最後的元氣。更宏觀地說，這場戰爭是宋、金、蒙三方力量均衡被打破的節點：金既不能守土，亦不能取償於宋，於是在蒙古南下時失去了縱深與盟友。
impactEn: The result of the war was the end of the Jin dynasty's last great invasion of the south. The Song held their ground on the Jingxiang, Huai-Yangtze and Shaanxi fronts; Zhao Fang, Meng Zongzheng and their colleagues held Zaoyang, Fancheng and Xingyuan and drove the Jin back out of southern Henan, which gave the Southern Song decades of frontier buffer, and the Jingxiang line became the base from which the Song later faced the Mongols, a position on which the strategy of the Duanping advance into Luoyang and the joint campaign against Caizhou both depended. Technologically, the experience of both sides in these years was recorded and handed on: the defenders sank pits against tunnels, used poison smoke and fire and leather bellows, and sealed the wall with crescent works and fire-pits, while the besiegers worked with ladders, gangways, tunnels and night attacks, and both sides learned much more about large siege engines and bombardment; these lessons were tested again in the ten-year defence of Xiangyang against the Mongols. The change in the military system was deeper still: the refugees from the Central Plains came back to Song in numbers and were enrolled as the Zhunshun army, and together with the Red Coat bands of Li Quan and the loyalist volunteers of many districts the frontier forces of Song began to turn into private armies dominated by their commanders; Li Quan thus went from a Red Coat chief to a titled commissioner, and from then on the armed strength of the Huai east was very largely beyond the court's control, which was both a hidden danger for the Song frontier and a source of anxiety when the Duanping advance into Luoyang was launched. For the Jin the losses were fatal in the long run: the cavalry of the Pufu was reduced to a fraction of itself, men and wealth were exhausted, and the Mongols pressed from the north until Caizhou fell in 1234 and the state perished. Seen in the larger picture, this war was the point at which the balance between Song, Jin and Mongol broke down: the Jin could neither hold its own land nor make good its losses on Song, and so when the Mongols came south they had neither depth nor allies.
result: 三道攻宋的結局是一條一條寫出來的。西路金軍一二一九年二月破興元府、進破大安軍與洋州，卻在川東遭宋將張威使石宣邀擊，損精兵三千，巴士魯安被擒，殘部北遁。中路完顏訛可大軍攻棗陽，築外壘、鑿地道、焚城樓，圍城八十餘日不下；七月孟宗政、扈再興合擊，賈勇突入金營，殺其眾三萬，訛可單騎遁走，宋軍追至馬磴寨、焚城而入鄧州，金人自此不敢窺襄漢棗陽。東路金軍渡淮，圍安豐軍及滁、濠、光三州，遊騎至采石楊林渡，建康震動，終被李全等部擊退於化湖陂、曹家莊，金自是不敢窺淮東。一二二〇年十月宋方轉守為攻，趙方遣三將帥六萬分三道北伐，扈再興攻鄧州、許國攻唐州皆不克而還，金軍乘勢反攻樊城三日不下，北退；一二二一年金軍再至漢陽軍，抵長江而還；一二二二年訛可再統三路渡淮，敗於高塘市，遇淮水暴漲全軍覆沒，被誅而死；至一二二四年，金主遣使通好，移剌蒲阿至光州榜諭軍民不再南侵，戰事至此收束。從兵器史的角度看，配重投石車在這場戰爭中沒有扮演主角：金軍有攻城之器而缺組織與後勤，宋軍有守城之術而無攻城之器，最後決定勝負的是城防工程、指揮與補給。
resultEn: The outcome of the three-pronged war can be read line by line. In the west the Jin took Xingyuan prefecture in the second month of 1219 and pushed on into Da'an army and Yangzhou prefecture, but in eastern Sichuan they were intercepted by the Song general Zhang Wei through Shi Xuan, lost three thousand of their picked troops, and Busilu'an was taken prisoner; the rest withdrew north. In the centre the army of Wanyan Nianke attacked Zaoyang, throwing up an outer work, cutting tunnels and burning the towers, and did not take the city in more than eighty days; in the seventh month Meng Zongzheng and Hu Zaixing struck together, Jia Yong burst into the Jin camp, thirty thousand of the enemy were killed, Nianke fled alone on horseback, and the Song pursued them to the Mading stockade, burned the town and entered Dengzhou, after which the Jin did not venture against Jingxiang or Zaoyang again. In the east the Jin crossed the Huai, invested Anfeng army and the prefectures of Chu, Hao and Guang, their outriders reached the Yanglin ford at Caishi and Jiankang was shaken, and they were finally driven back by the troops of Li Quan and others at Hualhubi and Caojiazhuang, after which the Jin did not look towards the Huai east again. In the tenth month of 1220 the Song turned from defence to attack: Zhao Fang sent the three commanders with sixty thousand men along three routes, Hu Zaixing against Dengzhou and Xu Gou against Tangzhou, and both returned without success; the Jin followed them up and assaulted Fancheng for three days without taking it and withdrew north. In 1221 the Jin came again to Hanyang army and as far as the Yangtze before turning back; in 1222 Nianke led his three routes across the Huai once more, was beaten at Gaotangshi, and when the river rose the whole army was drowned and he was put to death. By 1224 the khan sent an envoy to propose peace, and Molu Pu'an reached Guangzhou with a proclamation that the army would invade no further, and the fighting came to an end. From the point of view of the history of weapons, the counterweight trebuchet did not play the leading part in this war: the Jin had siege engines but lacked organisation and supply, and the Song had the arts of defence but no siege engines, and what settled the outcome in the end were the works of fortification, the command and the logistics.
